Export & trade policy

Trade made simpler with IUAE-CEPA

The Indonesia–UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement opens preferential access for Indonesian cocoa products.

Direct from Indonesia to Jebel Ali

Containerised shipments leave Indonesian ports and arrive at Jebel Ali, the main gateway for the UAE and wider MENA distribution.

0%

Import tariff advantage

Preferential duty treatment for qualifying Indonesian goods, subject to origin rules and a valid Certificate of Origin.

Fast

Faster customs clearance

CEPA-aligned procedures and complete, pre-checked documentation reduce time at Jebel Ali.

Halal

BPJPH Halal certified

Certified by Indonesia’s Halal Product Assurance Agency, supporting entry into Halal-sensitive Gulf markets.

*Tariff treatment depends on the HS line and CEPA rules of origin at the time of import. Please confirm with your customs broker.

How an order works

Inquiry

Share your volume, grade and Incoterm.

Samples & quote

Evaluate samples and receive a formal offer.

Documents

Proforma, L/C or T/T, Certificate of Origin, COA, Halal certificate, packing list.

Shipment

FOB Indonesian port or CIF Jebel Ali, with tracking.

Supported Incoterms

  • FOB: you arrange freight from the Indonesian port
  • CIF Jebel Ali: we arrange freight and insurance to Dubai

Document pack

  • Certificate of Origin (CEPA)
  • Certificate of Analysis
  • BPJPH Halal certificate
  • Commercial invoice & packing list
